paragraphs: Anonymous Health sells artificial intelligence software to behavioral health providers, positioned as enterprise class AI for that field. Its central product is described as the world's first AI contact center for behavioral health.

The system handles every call, chat or text on the spot. Intake is automated from paperwork through scheduling. The channels listed are phone, SMS and web chat, running at all hours. Another feature offers real-time coaching to admissions teams at what the site calls the most critical moment of the patient journey. Phone engagement is offered for overflow and overnight calls. During residential stays, interactive programming prepares patients for return to community and for IOP or PHP engagement. Reminder sequences and content programming are used to keep patients engaged. An alumni app is said to support alumni relationships and community referrals.

The site says the company was founded in 2022 by Dr. Angie Chen and other clinical leaders to solve longstanding problems identified in her clinical practice. It describes early work serving thousands of high-risk Medicaid patients. The company claims its automation improves therapist well-being and boosts efficiency by up to 40 percent. Its stated aim is connecting people in recovery with the care they deserve.

quote.text: Connecting people in recovery with the care they deserve.
